module purpose: neorv32_cpu_cp_cfu stores four 32-bit CSR-programmable words, latches rs1_i and rs2_i for an accepted r3-type request, updates internal operand/sum/result state according to funct3_i and the stored words, returns the addressed stored word on csr_rdata_o, and reports a 32-bit result with valid_o.

use-case flows.value: a 32-bit CSR word written into the selected slot of the internal four-word memory
the selected stored CSR word returned on csr_rdata_o
acceptance of an r3-type request and capture of rs1_i and rs2_i into internal operand registers
update of the internal sum and result from the captured operands, the stored CSR words and funct3_i-selected arithmetic branches
result_o and valid_o selected from the computed result, the done state, or constant zero/one according to rtype_i and funct3_i
internal CSR memory and core state cleared to zero while rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.reasoning: Lines 178-179 write csr_wdata_i into key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) when csr_we_i='1'; line 185 reads the selected word back on csr_rdata_o; and lines 236-238 use a selected key_mem word as tmp_z for the arithmetic result path. Integrity is Established because both readout and computation depend on the exact stored 32-bit words and their addressed slot. Availability is also Established because key_mem stores the words across cycles until reset (lines 175-176, 179) and csr_rdata_o continuously returns the addressed word (line 185).

conceptual assets.concept: Requested operation code and start qualification
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module uses start_i and rtype_i to accept an operation at line 204, and uses funct3_i to choose the implemented branches: lines 213-218 select xtea.sum behavior, lines 221-237 select add/subtract and operand/key selection, and lines 247-256 select which result/valid branch is reported. Integrity is Established because a wrong request code makes the module execute a different operation or report the wrong branch outcome. Availability is Established only as implemented: when start_i='1' and rtype_i=r3type_c the request is accepted (lines 204-207), while unsupported funct3_i values are forced to zero/invalid (lines 254-256, 261-262).

On an accepted start, xtea.opa <= rs1_i and xtea.opb <= rs2_i (lines 204-206). The core later uses these stored values to initialize xtea.sum (line 214) and to derive tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y (lines 232-235), which feed tmp_r and xtea.res (lines 238, 222-224). Integrity is Established because the reported arithmetic result depends on the exact captured operands; availability is also Established because xtea.opa and xtea.opb retain them until reset or a later accepted start (lines 194-195, 205-206).

When xtea.done(0)='1', xtea.sum is either loaded from xtea.opa, incremented by xtea_delta_c, or decremented by xtea_delta_c (lines 213-218). Lines 236-238 then use xtea.sum both to select which key_mem word becomes tmp_z and to contribute to tmp_r. Integrity is Established because wrong xtea.sum changes the selected stored word and the computed arithmetic state; availability is also Established because xtea.sum is held in a register and self-updated until reset (lines 196, 214, 216, 218).

When xtea.done(0)='1', xtea.res stores tmp_b +/- tmp_r depending on funct3_i(1) (lines 221-224). The report path forwards xtea.res to result_o only for the four arithmetic funct3_i cases and only when rtype_i=r3type_c (lines 245, 247-250). Integrity is Established because consumers of result_o must receive exactly the value defined by those arithmetic relations; availability is also Established because xtea.res is registered and result_o exposes it in the selected report branch.

xtea.done(0) is asserted on an accepted start (line 207), xtea.done(1) <= xtea.done(0) delays that state by one cycle (line 201), and valid_o reports xtea.done(1) for the four arithmetic funct3_i cases (line 250), '1' for xtea_init_c (line 253), and '0' otherwise or for non-r3type requests (lines 256, 262). Integrity is Established because the consumer depends on the exact result-valid/completion decision, not just the result value. Availability is also Established because the module explicitly produces one of these valid_o outcomes and clears the stored state on reset (lines 193, 200-201).
